Messages.Author: Trigger
Messages.Body: I have a question about VP's and players being eliminated simultaneously. If a referendum passes that eliminates all players due to reducing their pool by a certain amount, how does the Victory Points get dished out? Only the player who played the card gets 1 VP for ousting his prey? No one else gets any VP’s?

Messages.Author: Haze
Messages.Body: every player would get 1 VP simultaneously in this case

Messages.Author: CryWolf
Messages.Body:
IANPB, but I'll try answering this.

Based on the  Rulebook ,  9.1 Victory Points :
>
> You get a victory point whenever the Methuselah who is your prey is ousted (no matter how or by whom your prey was ousted).
>
So given the ff situation:  Players A -> B -> C B is at 3 pool and C is at 1 pool It is A's turn  A vampire controlled by A calls a KRC, splitting the points 3-1 between B and C. It passes. B and C simultaneously take the damage assigned. They are ousted at the same time too.
According to the ruling:  B gets 1 VP because C was ousted. A gets 1 VP for ousting B. A gets 1 more VP for being the last Meth standing.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Correct answer from Crywolf.

Also: if you call a referendum that ousts all players (including you), everyone gets 1 VP, because your prey just got ousted. Noone gets a VP for being the Last Methuselah Standing. (making it 1-1-1-1-1 in a 5-player table).

Messages.Author: Trigger
Messages.Body: Perfect. Thats exactly what I was needing to clarrify. The reson I asked is I ousted my prey first for 1 VP, then could have called a vote to then oust everyone including myself which would have ended the game and me with 2 VP and everyone else left with 1 VP. I didn't do it as I wanted to make sure it worked this way first. NEXT time, I will certainly play it that way for the win.
